header.running_head: Occupation with the Ahadeeth of Rasulullaah ﷺ and Befitting Behaviour for those Occupied with this

blocks.text: Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) also said, "It is only befitting that a man of the Qur'aan be recognised by his nights (when he is engaged in Ibaadah) when others are asleep, by his days (spent fasting) when others are eating, by his sorrow (pondering about his plight in the Aakhirah) when others are rejoicing, by his weeping when others are laughing, by his silence when others are socialising and by his humility when others are behaving arrogantly. It is also befitting of a man of the Qur'aan to be weeping and sorrowful, wise and tolerant, knowledgeable and composed. It does not behove a man of the Qur'aan to be uncouth, negligent, boisterous, rowdy and short-tempered."

Another narration states that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) said, "Do your best to be a listener (rather than always speaking) and take careful note when you hear Allaah say, 'O you who have Imaan!' because it is only something good that you are being instructed to do or something evil that you are being prohibited from." [^1]
Occupation with the Ahadeeth of Rasulullaah ﷺ and Befitting Behaviour for those Occupied with this
A Bedouin Questions Rasulullaah ﷺ about Qiyaamah when he was Busy Narrating Ahadeeth

Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ was busy narrating Ahadeeth when a Bedouin arrived and asked, "When will Qiyaamah take place?" When Rasulullaah ﷺ continued narrating, some of the Sahabah (RA) said that Rasulullaah ﷺ (was not giving a reply because he) heard the man but did not like the question. Others said that Rasulullaah ﷺ did not hear the man at all. When Rasulullaah ﷺ had completed narrating Ahadeeth, he asked, "Where is he (the Bedouin)?" "Here am I over here!" the man said. Rasulullaah ﷺ then said, "Wait for Qiyaamah when a time arrives in which trusts are misappropriated." "How will they be misappropriated?" the man asked. Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "Wait for Qiyaamah when authority is placed in the hands of unworthy people." [^2]
Hadhrat Waabisah (RA) Propagates a Hadith of Rasulullaah ﷺ in Conformance with the Instruction Rasulullaah ﷺ gave in his Farewell Sermon
